title: Cross-Engine Persistent-Search-Memory Causal Constitution, Berserk/Ethereal Semantic-Mediation Admission, Stockfish-Lineage→Engine-Family Naturality, Inanis Topology-Specific Transport & Lc0 Architecture-Neutral Boundary

language_policy.orchestration: Any language may be used when it reduces implementation risk; Python is not privileged and must not replace native engine code merely for uniformity.

causal_construct.name: persistent-search-memory semantic read
necessary_properties: The stored state persists beyond the immediate local node computation.
The search later queries that state while deciding search control, move ordering, evaluation reuse, pruning or expansion.
The intervention removes or selectively suppresses the decision-semantic read while leaving the underlying position, legal moves and write opportunity otherwise intact.
NATIVE and SHAM paths are behaviorally noninterfering under deterministic single-thread fixed-node tests.

r1_admission_gate.scope: recursive decision-semantic MAIN and QSEARCH TT reads; post-search ponder/report-only reads are excluded and must be enumerated
required: exact source lock + native build + UCI smoke
exhaustive static read-site census in scoped search regions
complete adapter mediation of every scoped semantic read site
baseline == instrumented NATIVE == instrumented SHAM on a frozen multi-FEN deterministic pack
SHAM dynamic engagement at both MAIN and QSEARCH sites
MASK_ALL == independently materialized SEMANTIC_REMOVAL binary on the same frozen pack

r2_transport_precommit.launch_condition: both berserk and ethereal pass R1
r2_transport_precommit.worlds: new outcome-blind exact worlds disjoint from P19 generation offsets and selected cells
r2_transport_precommit.selection_rule: SHAM-only engagement census before any selective intervention outcome

inanis.constraint: Do not force a MAIN/QSEARCH 1:1 homology when the locked qsearch lacks the same direct TT-read topology.
inanis.question: What quotient/translation preserves the intervention meaning when one search phase has no homologous direct persistent-memory read?

lc0.constraint: No Stockfish-style TT intervention in P20.
lc0.question: Which persistent state in neural tree/DAG search and neural-evaluation caching satisfies a future PSM_READ intervention contract?

adjudication_limits: Mixed curvature identifies endpoint interaction/functoriality failure, not A∘B != B∘A.
Cross-engine equivalence may be claimed only after independent admission of each engine-specific adapter.
WDL robustness is reported only when the engine exposes a directly observed compatible WDL field or exact-world joined move value; it is never inferred from centipawn score alone.
